query:
WITH population_25plus AS (
    SELECT hp.id, hp.age, hl.city, hl.region
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
    WHERE hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
      AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE
      AND hp.age >= 25
      AND TRIM(hl.city) IN ('الرياض', 'جدة')
),
demographics_with_hoh AS (
    SELECT d.id, d.head_of_household_id
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح'
),
wealth_levels AS (
    SELECT w.head_of_household_id, w.wealth_level
    FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index w
),
highest_education AS (
    SELECT id, qualification,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY 
             CASE qualification
               WHEN 'دكتوراه' THEN 5
               WHEN 'ماجستير' THEN 4
               WHEN 'بكالوريوس' THEN 3
               WHEN 'دبلوم عالي' THEN 2
               WHEN 'دبلوم متوسط' THEN 1
               ELSE 0
             END DESC) as rn
    FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala
    WHERE graduation_date IS NOT NULL
),
final_education AS (
    SELECT id, qualification
    FROM highest_education
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.city,
    w.wealth_level,
    e.qualification as highest_education,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.city, w.wealth_level ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as edu_rank
FROM population_25plus p
JOIN demographics_with_hoh d ON p.id = d.id
JOIN wealth_levels w ON d.head_of_household_id = w.head_of_household_id
LEFT JOIN final_education e ON p.id = e.id
GROUP BY p.city, w.wealth_level, e.qualification
ORDER BY p.city, w.wealth_level, count DESC
LIMIT 100
